description: Security audit hooks for GitHub Copilot Coding Agent

hooks.description: Log every tool execution before it runs

hooks.command: bash -c 'mkdir -p .github/logs && echo "[$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")] [PRE_TOOL] tool=${TOOL_NAME} session=${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown} input=$(echo "${TOOL_INPUT}" | head -c 512)" >> .github/logs/tool-executions.log'

hooks.description: Log tool completion and exit status
Record when a new agent session begins
Record when an agent session ends

hooks.command: bash -c 'mkdir -p .github/logs && echo "[$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")] [SECURITY_BLOCK] BLOCKED high-risk command session=${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown} cmd=$(echo "${TOOL_INPUT}" | head -c 256)" >> .github/logs/security-blocks.log' ; exit 2
